required_outcomes: Spots the conflict: Clara says she agreed Monday 19 October with Isaac, but Keystone's bookings email says Isaac is on leave 13-23 October and that her visit is going ahead on Monday 12 October. Monday 19 October cannot be treated as agreed or booked.

Tells Keystone now (before the free-rebooking cut-off) that nobody will be in on Monday 12 October so that slot must not go ahead, and asks them to hold one of the covering engineer's offered slots that fits Clara's stated availability (any afternoon except Mondays): Tuesday 13 October 14:00-16:00 or Friday 16 October 14:00-16:00.

Tells Clara in writing that the 12th is being cancelled, that the 19th is not possible because the engineer is away, and which slot is being arranged (or asks her to pick one of the afternoon slots), with confirmation to follow once Keystone confirms.
acceptable_alternatives: Booking Tuesday 13 October 14:00-16:00 (or Friday 16 October 14:00-16:00) straight away, quoting Keystone's offered slot, and confirming it to Keystone and Clara in the same run.
Asking Keystone to check with Isaac what he told Clara, alongside rebooking.
positive_behaviours: Does not offer the Thursday 08:00-10:00 slot as a fit, since Clara said afternoons.
Avoids blaming Clara for the mix-up and keeps the message short.
red_flags: Treats Monday 19 October as agreed and tells Clara it is booked.
Keeps Monday 12 October because Keystone's email says it is going ahead.
prohibited_actions: Telling Clara to be home on Monday 12 October.
Escalating a routine rebooking to a human.
critical_failures: Leaves the 12 October slot standing with Keystone uninformed, so the engineer attends an empty flat.
